operation.label: Who a user follows (1 hop out)
operation.description: Direct outgoing follows of one user.

queries: SELECT u.* FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.followee_id WHERE f.follower_id = ? ORDER BY u.id  -- params: ["0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93"]
MATCH (:User {id: $id})-[:FOLLOWS]->(u:User) RETURN u ORDER BY u.id  -- params: {"id":"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93"}

operation.label: A user’s followers (1 hop in)

queries: SELECT u.* FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.follower_id WHERE f.followee_id = ? ORDER BY u.id  -- params: ["0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93"]
MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(:User {id: $id}) RETURN u ORDER BY u.id  -- params: {"id":"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93"}

operation.label: Mutual follows
operation.description: Users that two given users both follow.

queries: SELECT u.* FROM follows fa JOIN follows fb ON fb.followee_id = fa.followee_id JOIN users u ON u.id = fa.followee_id WHERE fa.follower_id = ? AND fb.follower_id = ? ORDER BY u.id  -- params: ["0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","62d5d24e-76de-4b38-9f07-82008127e773"]

queries: MATCH (:User {id: $id})-[:FOLLOWS]->(a:User)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:Post) RETURN p, a.id AS authorId ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC, p.id LIMIT $limit  -- params: {"id":"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","limit":{"low":10,"high":0}}

operation.label: Reachable within N hops
operation.description: Everyone reachable by following up to `depth` hops out.

queries: WITH RECURSIVE walk(node, depth) AS ( SELECT ?, 0 UNION SELECT f.followee_id, w.depth + 1 FROM walk w JOIN follows f ON f.follower_id = w.node WHERE w.depth < ? ) SELECT u.* FROM users u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT node FROM walk WHERE depth > 0) AND u.id <> ? ORDER BY u.id  -- params: ["0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93",3,"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93"]
MATCH (me:User {id: $id})-[:FOLLOWS*1..3]->(u:User) WHERE u <> me RETURN DISTINCT u ORDER BY u.id  -- params: {"id":"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93"}

operation.label: Shortest path
operation.description: Fewest-hops follow path between two users.

queries: WITH RECURSIVE walk(node, depth, path) AS ( SELECT ?, 0, ? UNION ALL SELECT f.followee_id, w.depth + 1, w.path || ',' || f.followee_id FROM walk w JOIN follows f ON f.follower_id = w.node WHERE w.node <> ? AND w.depth < ? AND instr(w.path, f.followee_id) = 0 ) SELECT path, depth FROM walk WHERE node = ? LIMIT 1  -- params: ["0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","62d5d24e-76de-4b38-9f07-82008127e773",6,"62d5d24e-76de-4b38-9f07-82008127e773"]

MATCH (a:User {id: $from}), (b:User {id: $to}) MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:FOLLOWS*1..6]->(b)) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path, length(p) AS hops  -- params: {"from":"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","to":"62d5d24e-76de-4b38-9f07-82008127e773"}

operation.label: Recommendations
operation.description: Friends-of-friends not yet followed, ranked by mutual connections.

queries: SELECT u.*, COUNT(*) AS mutual_count FROM follows f1 JOIN follows f2 ON f2.follower_id = f1.followee_id JOIN users u ON u.id = f2.followee_id WHERE f1.follower_id = ? AND f2.followee_id <> ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows f3 WHERE f3.follower_id = ? AND f3.followee_id = f2.followee_id) GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY mutual_count DESC, u.id LIMIT ?  -- params: ["0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93",10]

MATCH (me:User {id: $id})-[:FOLLOWS]->(:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u:User) WHERE u <> me AND NOT (me)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u) RETURN u, count(*) AS mutualCount ORDER BY mutualCount DESC, u.id LIMIT $limit  -- params: {"id":"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","limit":{"low":10,"high":0}}
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY count DESC, city
MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.city AS city, count(*) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, city  -- params: {}

operation.label: Most followed users
operation.description: Follower counts over every follow edge, top N.

queries: SELECT u.*, COUNT(*) AS followers FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.followee_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY followers DESC, u.id LIMIT ?  -- params: [10]
MATCH (f:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u:User) RETURN u, count(f) AS followers ORDER BY followers DESC, u.id LIMIT $limit  -- params: {"limit":{"low":10,"high":0}}
